distinct_from.family: OG-SYNTH-0.3 package_A cost_risk (bottom-up triangular cost build-up with Bernoulli risk events)
distinct_from.reason: That family is a bottom-up cost model over a quantified cost risk register. This family is the top-down earned-value index model the production module actually implements. They are different conceptual models and neither is an oracle for the other.

inputs_actually_read.bac: budget at completion, must be > 0 or the module abstains
inputs_actually_read.cpi: cost performance index, must be > 0 or the module abstains
inputs_actually_read.spi: schedule performance index, must be > 0 or the module abstains
inputs_actually_read.docRiskScore: document risk score, clamped to [0,1], defaults to 0 when absent

inputs_not_read.ac: actual cost is not an input to this module
inputs_not_read.ev: earned value is not an input to this module
inputs_not_read.formula_selection_rule: there is none: the module applies one transformation unconditionally
inputs_not_read.cusum_penalty: monte_carlo_eac accepts cusumBreached, cusumDrift and cusumThreshold, but run_monte_carlo never passes them, so on the production path the penalty is always zero

eac_transformation: mode EAC = bac / cpi, the index-based independent estimate at completion
spread_driver: s = clamp(0.5*(1-cpi) + 0.3*(1-spi) + 0.2*docRiskScore, 0, 1) on the production path

distribution.sampling: beta variate by ratio of two Marsaglia-Tsang gamma variates, each gamma driven by Box-Muller normals over the base generator
distribution.degenerate_case: when p - o < 1e-9 every sample is exactly mEAC, so the forecast collapses deterministically

correlation: none: a single scalar is sampled per iteration, so there is no correlation structure to declare
truncation: none beyond the [o,p] support of the Beta-PERT itself

rng.implementation: mulberry32, unsigned 32-bit, bit-for-bit as the browser runs it

percentile_convention: index based on the ascending sample, i = floor(q*(N-1)), no interpolation
rounding: no rounding of the percentile figures; the evidence sentence formats to zero and one decimal place for display only
abstention_rules: bac, cpi or spi absent: abstain
bac not greater than zero: abstain with the no-positive-budget reason
cpi or spi not greater than zero: abstain with the zero-or-below-performance reason
no fallback budget and no fallback index exists: the removed DEMO_BAC substitution must never return

acceptance_rule.justification: alpha 0.001 is 0.05 Bonferroni corrected across fifty mean checks in the programme. The rule is fixed before any result is computed.

owner_prose_alias_note: STALE LABEL, RECONCILED BY THE RUN-28 CLOSURE. This field recorded `Monte Carlo EAC Forecast` as the OWNER'S PROSE name against a registry that said `Monte Carlo EAC`. The owner has since decided that A1.1's canonical identity IS `Monte Carlo EAC Forecast` and the naming authority p0-baseline/module_renumbering_map.csv was updated on that decision, so the name is no longer an alias for anything: it is the canonical name and it now sits in canonical_module_name. The alias field is nulled rather than deleted so a reader of the fixture's history can see that the disagreement existed and how it was settled.
